code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seed = {(0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1)}
    shapes = set()
    for reflected in (False, True):
        pts = [(r, c if not reflected else -c) for r, c in seed]
        for _ in range(4):
            mr, mc = min(r for r, c in pts), min(c for r, c in pts)
            shapes.add(frozenset((r-mr, c-mc) for r, c in pts))
            pts = [(c, -r) for r, c in pts]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for shape in shapes:
        sh, sw = max(r for r,c in shape)+1, max(c for r,c in shape)+1
        for r in range(h-sh+1):
            for c in range(w-sw+1):
                if all(grid[r+a][c+b] == 0 for a,b in shape):
                    for a,b in shape: out[r+a][c+b] = 7
    return out
'''
